orgId.title: Organization ID
orgId.description: Organization identifier for IT alerting, for example org_ab12cd34ef56.

userEmail.title: User email
userEmail.description: Employee email address attached to alerts for attribution.

universalMode.title: Universal mode
universalMode.description: Scan every website for secrets, including sites outside the AI chat list.

customPatterns.title: Custom patterns
customPatterns.description: One regular expression per entry, matched against text about to be sent.

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: When true, protection stays on and the detection categories cannot be changed in the popup.

detectPii.title: Detect personal data
detectPii.description: Enable personal-data detection (emails, phones, cards, national identity numbers for 20+ countries). Also available to employees through the popup.

detectNetwork.title: Detect IP addresses
detectNetwork.description: Enable IP address detection. Also available to employees through the popup.

enforceJustification.title: Enforce justification
enforceJustification.description: When true, sending after a warning requires a one-line reason that is shared with the IT admin.

autoRedact.title: Auto-redact
autoRedact.description: When true (Pro), high-confidence secrets are redacted automatically at send time.

blockSendAnyway.title: Block send anyway
blockSendAnyway.description: When true, sending after a warning is not allowed.

alertOnWarn.title: Alert on warn
alertOnWarn.description: Send an alert on every warning.

alertOnSendAnyway.title: Alert on send anyway
alertOnSendAnyway.description: Send an alert when a user sends anyway.

alertOnBlock.title: Alert on block
alertOnBlock.description: Send an alert when a user cancels.

alertOnRedact.title: Alert on redact
alertOnRedact.description: Send an alert when a user redacts.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Enable periodic heartbeat to the worker.
